item.title: COP17: Nations chart ‘Yerevan Pathway’ to speed up action for nature
item.description: At the halfway mark to 2030, countries meeting in Armenia have agreed a roadmap to accelerate action for nature, after a global review found the world off track to meet its biodiversity targets.

item.title: Western Sahara: UN ‘stands ready’ to keep supporting peace efforts as MINURSO mission ends
item.description: The UN remains committed to supporting a just, lasting and mutually acceptable political solution in Western Sahara that provides for the self-determination of its people, Secretary-General António Guterres said on Sunday, as the UN peacekeeping mission there began to wind down.
